cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shop's shut, but you're not dismissed. I taught you to close this till; let's see whether it stuck.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cash counted, drawer locked. My daughter's waiting outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you remembered the easy bits. Bring her in while you show me the closing report.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I sent you the report. Our taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Efficient—finally. I'll read it beside your taxi. Keep the door open; if you've followed my method, I should be able to release you before the meter hurts.

reason: Replace detachable teacher prefixes with corrections and influence claims that materially shape the specific pursuit, keeping B contributions causal.
